project_overview.description: Indonesian accounting/bookkeeping app for a renovation company with 4 user roles.
project_overview.emotional_tone: Professional, trustworthy, grounded, industrial, approachable for field workers.
project_overview.theme: Light theme default for field outdoor visibility. High contrast.

headings.rules: Use for all headings. Tracking tight for larger sizes.

body.rules: Use for body, data tables, and numbers for high legibility.

colors.archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST
colors.rules: No full-screen gradients. High contrast for readability outdoors. Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text.

layouts.general: High Density Grid for data dashboards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Mobile-first responsive.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8) for containers. Tight gaps (gap-4) for data widgets.
layouts.surface: Solid backgrounds for data clarity (NO glassmorphism for data tables). 1px subtle borders (border-slate-200). Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius).

components.forms: Short, validated. Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Left-align labels.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded. Distinct hover states.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Zebra striping or clear row borders. Include IDR formatting for all currencies (Rp).
components.photo_upload: Custom Base64 uploader for 'Nota' (Receipts) with preview. Mandatory for 'Tim' role.
components.icons: lucide-react. Use construction/finance metaphors (HardHat, Building2, Wallet, FileText, Camera).

role_based_access.Owner: Full access. Dashboard with app-wide activity feed, user management, project & location management.
role_based_access.Penagihan: Billing dashboard. Manage 'Tagihan' (Invoices) per project/client. Send/Export reminders.
role_based_access.Bendahara: Treasurer dashboard. Review 'Buku Kas' (Cash Book) from all locations. Calculate team pay. Assign PIC.
role_based_access.Tim: Field team dashboard. Add income/expense 'Buku Kas' with Base64 'Nota'. Add 'Kasbon' (Cash advance). View location history. Mobile-friendly view.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle, realistic shadows. E.g., shadow-sm for cards, shadow-md on hover.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid slate-200 on cards. Grid Borders for data-heavy sections.
visual_enhancers.motion: Fast, subtle micro-interactions. Hover lifts (-translate-y-1) on cards.

images.description: Blueprint of a building, perfect for an architectural/construction login screen.

accessibility.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. Text over images must have dark overlay.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JS/JSX files only (.js, .jsx). Do not use TypeScript (.ts, .tsx).
Format all currency values as IDR (Rp 1.000.000).
For the 'Tim' role, the camera/photo upload must compress or convert the image to base64 format for storage.
Build Shadcn components by customizing standard HTML/Tailwind.
Ensure the UI is responsive, especially for the 'Tim' role which will use it on mobile devices in the field.
Apply `data-testid` to all inputs, buttons, and links.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (not on data tables).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx
